answer: With a Dedicated device bound by DNS record proof with one identity per channel, the account is only as strong as its binding: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the DNS record proof is recorded, and one identity per channel keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so losing the channel means losing the identity, and fakes cannot hide behind throwaway channels. One summit proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of bindings. When the plume settles over the mirror, the binding holds because every channel answered its own challenge.
